messages.subject: introductions
messages.body_plain:
Hey everyone, join up and say hello! Everyone is welcome to join, whether you are an experienced R user, a new user or just curious. I'm hoping to organize some informal (i.e. pub-based) meetups over the summer, and to start formal monthly meetups with presentations in the autumn. Please post a short intro of yourself when you join so we can get the conversation started.

I am a software developer trained as an economist, and I've been using R for about 10 years. I use R regularly and do a lot of work with documenting R and writing refreshable documents which incorporate R output, via an open source software package I wrote called Dexy (http://dexy.it).
